bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: MIXED-BASIS FILING, same structure as this bank's own 2026_Q1.json: only a full Consolidated Balance Sheet/Profit and Loss Account is printed (no complete separate Solo statement, unlike FY2023-2025); total_assets/total_liabilities/total_equity/total_deposits/gross_loans/off_balance_sheet_exposures/reserves and P&L cumulative lines below are therefore CONSOLIDATED, while classified_loans/npl_pct/provision_required/provision_maintained/provision_surplus_deficit are Solo-basis (Note 8.10/8.11, On-shore + Off-shore Banking Unit only) per this bank's established convention -- npl_pct is deliberately computed against the matching Solo total-loans denominator (Tk.96,277.106166m), not the Consolidated gross_loans figure used elsewhere in this record (Tk.96,512.143536m). Supplementary Solo (of-the-Bank) figures directly available this quarter: NAV per share (Note 37.1) 13.66 vs 13.71 Consolidated; EPS (Note 38.1) 0.17 (PAT Tk.138,045,601) vs 0.17 Consolidated (PAT Tk.138,545,558, rounds the same); shareholders' equity (Note 37.1) Tk.11,260,294,652 vs Tk.11,300,860,403 Consolidated (subsidiary contributes 0.36%). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (H1); this filing also prints a discrete 'April to June' column, recorded separately below (not used for the cumulative fields, per this dataset's standing convention). CONTINUED IMPROVEMENT IN ASSET QUALITY FROM THE FY2025 CRISIS PEAK, though still severe: Solo NPL fell further to 16.17% (Tk.15,572,683,043 classified) from 18.50% at 31-Mar-2026 and 19.92% at 31-Dec-2025 -- a third consecutive quarter of improvement, though still roughly 3x the pre-crisis (FY2023) level. The loans-and-advances provision shortfall (Note 8.10) narrowed further to Tk.6,643,692,900 (required 9,644,592,342 vs maintained 3,000,899,442) from Tk.7,461,629,290 at 31-Mar-2026 and Tk.10,235,750,153 at 31-Dec-2025 -- a fourth consecutive quarter of narrowing (including the FY2025 annual figure). Note 8.10's own footnote again cites the same two Bangladesh Bank letters already found in this bank's 2026_Q1.json (BSD-5/106/2026-389 dated 26 April 2026, and BSD-5/106/2026-403 dated 28 April 2026 permitting finalization without full provision adjustment) -- both dated before this quarter's own 30 June 2026 reporting date, meaning no NEW letter has yet been found specifically covering H1-2026; the Bank appears to still be relying on the same April 2026 permissions. Quarterly profitability improved materially: discrete Q2-2026 PAT (Tk.22,826,481) was up sharply from discrete Q1-2026 (Tk.115,719,077 minus this quarter's own comparative gives an implied Q1 PAT close to the already-recorded figure) and, more strikingly, up 433% year-on-year from discrete Q2-2025's Tk.4,281,219 (per this filing's own comparative column) -- consistent with the gradual post-crisis stabilization visible in the shrinking NPL ratio and provision shortfall. No capital-adequacy disclosure found in this filing.
